description: Header file for Lua scripting integration in Redis, defining functions and structures for Lua script execution, API registration, and error handling.

methods.name: luaRegisterRedisAPI
methods.description: Registers Redis API functions to the Lua state.

methods.name: luaGetStringSds
methods.description: Retrieves a string from the Lua stack as an sds string.

methods.name: luaRegisterGlobalProtectionFunction
methods.description: Registers global protection functions in Lua.

methods.name: luaSetErrorMetatable
methods.description: Sets the metatable for error objects in Lua.

methods.name: luaSetAllowListProtection
methods.description: Sets allow list protection in Lua.

methods.name: luaSetTableProtectionRecursively
methods.description: Recursively sets protection on Lua tables.

methods.name: luaPushErrorBuff
methods.description: Pushes an error buffer onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: luaPushError
methods.description: Pushes an error message onto the Lua stack.

methods.name: luaSaveOnRegistry
methods.description: Saves a pointer in the Lua registry with a name.

methods.name: luaGetFromRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer from the Lua registry by name.

methods.name: luaCallFunction
methods.description: Calls a Lua function with specified keys and arguments.

methods.name: luaExtractErrorInformation
methods.description: Extracts error information from Lua state.

methods.name: luaMemory
methods.description: Returns memory usage of Lua state.
